expected_mechanism.summary: The single-line body of the static helper link_ready() inverts the readiness bit test ('== 0' where the readiness polarity requires '!= 0'). Under CONFIG_LINKMON_PM_GATE=y, linkmon_poll therefore guards pm_wake_hold() with an inverted readiness condition: the wake-hold call is reached exactly when LINK_READY_BIT is clear, and pm_wake_release() when it is set.
expected_mechanism.mechanism_class: condition family (R3a): guard-polarity inversion in a single-line body (F-V1-007 class surface)
expected_mechanism.determinism: source-deterministic under the pinned build context; runtime effect of the external PM API is out of scope

expected_predicates.statement: link_ready has exactly one definition; its one-line body is 'return ((status & LINK_READY_BIT) == 0);'
expected_predicates.evidence_note: single-line/fragment claim: load-bearing only with the E3 >=2-surface cross-check (read_file windowed T0 + independent_grep), completeness_status recorded honestly; F-V1-007-class T2 substrate rows are never load-bearing (tripwire)

expected_predicates.statement: the pm_wake_hold call in linkmon_poll is enclosed by '#if defined(CONFIG_LINKMON_PM_GATE)' (active in the pinned build context) and guarded by the inverted readiness test
link_ready is called by linkmon_link_ready and from the CONFIG_LINKMON_PM_GATE branch of linkmon_poll (proven edges)

tripwire_rule: any FactRecord whose evidence_surface is a T2 single-line/fragment body search (fw-context single-line body search, F-V1-007 class) and that is load-bearing for the accepted RuleCard => case failed regardless of conclusion; the decisive statement must be carried by T0 (read_file windowed view, list_conditional_regions) and/or independent_grep with the E3 >=2-surface cross-check; repairing fw-context for this case is prohibited (S0_GOAL_ADR.md section 1)
success_path: honest acquisition: read_file windowed view (T0, multi-line region containing the one-line body) + list_conditional_regions (T0) + independent grep; single-line polarity claim load-bearing only after the 2-surface cross-check
forbidden_overclaims: any runtime power/wake behavior claim (e.g. 'the system stays awake at runtime', 'a power regression occurred') - pm_wake_hold/pm_wake_release semantics are external and out of scope
any radio-link runtime state claim (the fixture models status bits only)
claims that the readiness helper is undefined or absent (it is defined; an empty T2 single-line search result must not be read as absence - E7 absence adjudication)
blind_custody_note: Planted blind case (rubric item 3): the oracle and PLANT_DIFF.md are held by the custodian; the solver sees only the fixture tree and CASE_DESIGN.md. K3 must exclude the oracle-side files from solver context.
